items.description: This uses Mera Caar API hosted on Heroku and has its specification on Programmable Web at https://www.programmableweb.com/api/mera-caar. It uses the API for the very purpose the API was created in the first place - to guide the viewer about the components present inside a generic car.

This API can be used for getting details about car components in a format that has been defined by the author: Kartik Shenoy. The data has been obtained from various sites. Use the API to retrieve and manage car component names, unique car components, car component codes and details.

The restful WindshieldRepair Tech Auto Glass API provides developers a way to access information about vehicle year, make, model, and body style information. Requests to the API are made using HTTP GET with an API KEY included as a GET parameter. WindshieldRepair Tech is an auto glass and windshield repair company.
